text:
**Probably yes, but it is not yet confirmed.**

- Satellite data (Hansen) shows 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property.
- The JRC 2020 map shows 98% of that area was forest in 2020.
- The 2021 national forest map classes 13.1 ha of it as native forest and none as planted. The other 0.4 ha is outside mapped forest.

This points to native forest being cleared or disturbed. However, 2025 is the latest year available, so no later year has been observed. The analysis rule requires that to corroborate a loss event, so the event is unconfirmed for now.

The data also can't say what caused the loss, such as clearing, fire or storm damage. It also can't say whether the forest will regrow. The engine is early-access, so I'd treat this as a flag to review. Checking 2026 data when it is released would help confirm it.
